title: Low quality, but cute.
text: Low quality, but cute.. The drawers in this advent calendar are small.  There isn't a lot of toy items I can think of that would fit in these drawers.  If you are sticking with candy or money, this calendar would work for you.  I find the quality to be poor.  I bumped mine on a wall when I was moving it and a portion of the Christmas tree the snowman is holding broke off.  Very expensive for what it is and it's quality.
